newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos sees strong gas demand.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos sees strong gas demand.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Monday it expected strong demand for gas in the future.
"We see a strong outlook for gas demand in terms of the extension of current contracts at current prices," Santos executive director John McArdle told reporters in Melbourne.
Earlier, Santos reported a half year net profit of A$88.6 million in the six months to June 30, 1996, compared with A$18.50 million a year earlier.

Santos, which meets 100 percent of South Australia state's gas needs, expects national demand for gas to strengthen, particularly on Australia's east coast, with the emergence of competition in the energy sector.

"We believe that competition policy actually provides opportunities for Santos. We don't see it as a threat. The people that will benefit from competition policy are those that have the gas to sell, and Santos certainly does," McArdle said.
"We are in a good position and we just need to maintain our position...," he added.
Santos is poised to become a major supplier of gas into Queensland state and demand in Australia's most populous state, New South Wales, will also grow strongly, McArdle told Reuters.

"New South Wales is just growing. We have a contract to supply most of that gas currently and there's a lot of demand," he said, adding that Bass Strait gas would be required within five years to help meet demand in that state.
Santos derives most of its revenue from production in the onshore Cooper/Eromanga Basins.
The Cooper Basin is in a very strong position to take advantage of emerging competitive gas markets in Australia, McArdle said. "Demand for Cooper Basin gas at current prices is strong...," he added.
Santos reported a 0.8 percent drop in sales volume despite record production for the first half of 1996, but McArdle said this reflected a rise in inventory to cope with peak demand.
"In this six months it is exacerbated because we boosted gas storage," he said.
